data.gender_notes: Merissa is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'meros' meaning sea, and 'issa' meaning goddess. Merissa was a minor Greek goddess of the sea, who protected sailors and fishermen. The name Merissa carries the meaning “Sea goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Merissa usually hope their child will grow to embody sea goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine protection and guidance in life's journeys.
data.etymology: Merissa belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sea goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Merissa total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Merissa has rich historical origins and was used by early Christians as an homage to the Greek goddess who protected seafarers from the treacherous waves. Even though the name is now predominantly Christian, it still has significant ties to the ancient maritime culture, symbolizing courage, endurance, and faith.
data.spiritual_significance: Merissa's name carries a deep spiritual meaning, evoking the protective, nurturing aspects of water - the essence of life and creation. It embodies a sense of connection to the divine that flows through the ocean waves and the spiritual journey of the soul. Merissa may inspire those bearing the name to embrace the endless possibilities that life offers and to search for a deeper sense of meaning and purpose.
